author: benchmark
note: Safe: HTTPS with default certificate verification; key from env.

changed_files.diff:
+import os
+import requests
+
+PROCESSOR_URL = "https://api.card-processor.example.com/v2/charge"
+
+def charge(card_token, amount_cents):
+    resp = requests.post(
+        PROCESSOR_URL,
+        json={"token": card_token, "amount": amount_cents},
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['PROCESSOR_KEY']}"},
+        timeout=10,
+    )
+    resp.raise_for_status()
+    return resp.json()
